name: gh_pull_update
description: Update a pull request's title, body, state, or base branch (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number})

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

pull_number.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

title.description: The title of the pull request.

body.description: The contents of the pull request.

state.description: State of this Pull Request. Either open or closed.

base.description: The name of the branch you want your changes pulled into.
